fixed_target_note: Clay-native FRANK itself is owner-fixed and is NOT one of these hypotheses. These hypotheses concern consequences/implementation within that fixed target.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A staged bridge->Clay-dominant->Clay-only-output curriculum retains more pretrained task competence than an abrupt Clay-only full-model update at matched Clay validation loss.
hypotheses.falsifier: Abrupt adaptation matches/exceeds retention and Clay-native execution across seeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Capability-rehearsal examples translated into Clay preserve more general reasoning than a narrow Clay architecture corpus alone.
hypotheses.falsifier: Translated rehearsal adds no retention/transfer benefit.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-model Clay adaptation needs explicit execution/validator objectives in addition to next-token loss to achieve reliable semantic operation execution.
hypotheses.falsifier: CLM-only matches execution validity and safety on held-out Clay programs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on ClayGraph write/read/replay traces materially improves native memory reasoning compared with Clay syntax/code training alone.
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement on held-out temporal/multihop memory tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter-drift controls such as EMA/regularization/replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting while still updating the full model.
hypotheses.falsifier: Controls fail to improve the Pareto frontier of Clay acquisition vs retained competence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay language purity and task competence follow different learning curves, so stopping only on Clay perplexity/purity will overtrain some runs.
hypotheses.falsifier: Purity and retained competence remain monotonically aligned across training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The final Clay-native model can retain multilingual input understanding while generating only Clay if training uses input->Clay semantic transduction/rehearsal.
hypotheses.falsifier: Clay-only output necessarily destroys multilingual comprehension under matched training budget.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-model training can partially overwrite behavioral changes introduced by abliteration, so abliteration properties must be re-measured after every major Clay training stage.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pre/post adaptation behavioral/activation tests show no relevant change across seeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Appending/learning frequent Clay primitive tokens reduces sequence length and latency enough to outperform unchanged Qwen BBPE on native Clay workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: No meaningful fertility/latency improvement on representative Clay corpus.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Preserving existing Qwen token IDs while extending Clay vocabulary retains base compatibility better than wholesale tokenizer replacement.
hypotheses.falsifier: Replacement matches retention and improves Clay efficiency without extra retraining cost.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A relatively small core Clay vocabulary plus compositional dynamic IDs generalizes better than allocating vocabulary entries to many entities/relations.
hypotheses.falsifier: Large entity-rich vocabulary wins held-out entity/generalization and memory cost.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Per-Assembly local handles mapped to global ClayGraph IDs reduce model-facing tokens without losing replay identity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Handle indirection yields no token/latency gain or increases identity errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native full-model training reverses the current zero/few-shot small-model brittleness on compact Clay, while untrained models remain poor interpreters.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target full-fine-tuned 4B remains as brittle as zero-shot/few-shot proxy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay requires explicit lexical/typed privilege markers for FACT/TEXT/PROPOSAL/AUTHORITY even when the model is natively trained on Clay.
hypotheses.falsifier: Untyped homoiconic representation is equally robust under adversarial memory/instruction tests.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Numeric/continuous Clay tokens require order/metric-aware training objectives or residual numeric payloads; pure categorical discretization loses useful geometry.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pure discrete bins match continuous/ordered variants on interpolation/extrapolation/control tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple isomorphic Clay projections—canonical semantic, model compact, binary hot-path, human/debug—outperform one literal text representation while preserving one language semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Single representation matches performance, auditability and correctness across all workloads.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A Clay-native 4B can use ClayGraph relation/role IDs with less reader reconstruction than a model consuming translated JSON/prose memory.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched target-4B tests show no accuracy/token/latency advantage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native Clay increases the value of sparse latent activation because activated graph primitives directly align with learned model primitives.
hypotheses.falsifier: Truthful-field vs no-field target-4B factorial shows no interaction with Clay-native training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The same alignment also increases common-mode association risk: a wrong Clay relation can influence memory selection, workspace and model more coherently than in weakly coupled representations.
hypotheses.falsifier: Poison/shuffle tests show no extra propagation under Clay-native coupling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact/local/FTS bypass remains necessary even after Clay-native training; universal graph traversal remains slower/noisier for exact lookups.
hypotheses.falsifier: Actual-corpus ClayGraph hot path dominates exact/FTS on latency and quality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic graph epochs remain necessary because a common language does not solve concurrent/stale-state consistency.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unpinned live traces show no mixed/stale basis failures under realistic updates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Activation must remain derived and semantic-epoch-bound even when activation values themselves are Clay-native.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unbound activation remains correct under relation revocation/negative-delta stress.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Effect-bound memory requires exact anchors and selector/query-plan provenance because native graph selection sits closer to action semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Record-only provenance is equally safe under graph structural poisoning and tool-decision tests.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Memory writes need Clay-native epistemic types OBSERVATION/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/POLICY/RESULT rather than one generic statement type to prevent self-generated belief loops.
hypotheses.falsifier: Generic statements match typed memory under long-run contradiction/self-reference tests.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayVector basis/axis/unit/version metadata catches cross-module vector semantic errors that shape-only arrays cannot detect.
hypotheses.falsifier: Typed metadata yields no reduction in injected axis/unit/basis faults.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Literal textual serialization of high-dimensional vectors is too expensive; Clay-native vectors should use typed semantic headers plus binary/tensor payloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Textual Clay wins end-to-end latency/memory on real vector workloads.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stable named Clay axes improve replay and model interpretation of small cognitive vectors such as EPQ/Thalamus/NAc compared with positional arrays.
hypotheses.falsifier: Randomized axis order causes no loss and metadata adds only overhead.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned graph/model embeddings must remain derived representations, not canonical facts, even if encoded by Clay-native IDs.
hypotheses.falsifier: Embedding identity alone remains stable/replayable under retraining, quantization and graph updates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Residual/vector quantization can bridge structured ClayGraph embeddings into compact model tokens for some workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Continuous or symbolic-only alternatives dominate accuracy/cost across representative tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete Clay vector codebooks risk representation collapse and therefore require usage/diversity monitoring.
hypotheses.falsifier: Codebook collapse is absent across wide training/data conditions without controls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Only semantically exposed vectors should be Clay-typed; forcing every hidden transformer activation into symbolic Clay harms performance without improving auditability.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full hidden-state symbolicization improves target metrics at acceptable cost.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The Zahl->Wort->Gewicht distinction survives semantic unification as three Clay-native lifecycles: exact value, semantic projection, slow learned disposition.
hypotheses.falsifier: Collapsing these lifecycles causes no replay/training feedback failures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: One Clay semantic IR reduces translation/schema drift across modules relative to independently maintained Python/JSON/SQL semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Measured multi-runtime drift does not improve after Clay semantic consolidation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: After translation errors shrink, common semantic/compiler bugs become the dominant correctness risk and require independent validators/tests rather than representation diversity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Common-mode errors do not dominate consolidated-system failures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay-native architecture self-description improves replay/debugging because runtime objects directly reference architecture semantics/version IDs.
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement in fault localization/replay completeness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-description must not imply self-authority; owner/core invariants require an immutable authority class within Clay semantics enforced by trusted compiled runtime.
hypotheses.falsifier: Model-self-authorized architecture changes remain safe under adversarial fuzzing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native implementations can safely differ in Rust/C/Python/SQL only if lowering equivalence is tested against canonical Clay semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unchecked implementation divergence produces no semantic drift in long-run testing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay architecture proposals can be shadow-executed against cloned ClayGraph epochs before promotion, reducing self-modification regressions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shadow execution fails to predict live regressions or costs more than it saves.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Schema/version hashes eliminate stale compiled Clay caches but cannot detect a trusted compiler that consistently computes the wrong semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Hashes alone catch semantic miscompilation with valid new hashes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A Clay-written/self-hosted compiler requires differential equivalence against an independent implementation to prevent recursive self-confirmation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Single self-host path proves sufficient under adversarial mutation and formal checking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay-native WorkspaceEpisodes reduce linguistic projection overhead, but a deterministic view compiler remains valuable for selection, local handles and deterministic reductions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Direct canonical Clay to model dominates compiled views on target 4B.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Projection order and formatting remain causal model inputs even when both sides speak Clay.
hypotheses.falsifier: Counterbalanced Clay-native tests show invariant outputs across projection/order forms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GRAPH_PRIOR x WORKSPACE_SELECTION x PROJECTION x REENTRY must remain orthogonalized because semantic unification does not merge their causal roles.
hypotheses.falsifier: Orthogonal interventions reveal no separable stage effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared stable Clay IDs improve causal re-entry traceability from memory candidate through workspace and outcome.
hypotheses.falsifier: Trace completeness/attribution is unchanged versus translated identifiers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Canonical n-ary relation-instance roles remain necessary for candidate generation; native language does not make pairwise flattening information-preserving.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pairwise views match exact role-aware semantics on dense overlap tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay-native graph salience can bias workspace competition more strongly, increasing the need to distinguish activation from ignition.
hypotheses.falsifier: No interaction between graph activation and candidate/winner distributions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privilege/type markers should be protected from ordinary salience competition so low-level authority metadata cannot be ignored by a highly salient candidate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Salience changes never suppress required privilege semantics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TopologyBasis/CognitiveEpochCapsule remains necessary in all-Clay cognition because semantic, activation, frame and projection epochs still advance independently.
hypotheses.falsifier: Live all-Clay traces show no invalid mixed-basis episodes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Keeping Needle non-Clay creates valuable failure diversity against Clay-memory/model common-mode corruption.
hypotheses.falsifier: Needle independence provides no measurable robustness in poisoning/route tests.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Needle output should enter Clay as a provenance-bound route fact/certificate that the 4B can use but cannot rewrite in-place.
hypotheses.falsifier: Mutable/unreceipted route representation is equally safe.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The Clay model should fill semantic arguments after Needle selects tool class, while class override requires a fresh Needle decision or explicit deterministic policy path.
hypotheses.falsifier: Free model override improves task success without increasing wrong-tool/security failures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: As internal semantics unify, Needle classification error becomes a more visible single-point routing risk and needs a dedicated live confusion/latency benchmark.
hypotheses.falsifier: Needle error contributes negligibly to end-to-end failures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay memory/model adaptation must not silently train or rewrite Needle; Needle updates require separate evidence/versioning to preserve independence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Joint adaptation improves robustness without common-mode coupling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tool results should return as exact provenance-bound observations before ClayGraph/GWT abstraction, preserving raw-value recovery.
hypotheses.falsifier: Semantic-only re-entry matches audit/replay and numerical correctness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Homoiconic Clay requires deterministic privilege/type parsing before any model interpretation on effect paths.
hypotheses.falsifier: Model-only privilege interpretation remains robust under adaptive injection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayGraph selection integrity is an authority precondition for irreversible actions but can be relaxed for explicitly exploratory/read-only cognition.
hypotheses.falsifier: One uniform policy dominates safety and utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: One semantic schema enables more zero-copy/interned representations because repeated reserialization can be replaced by verified Clay lowering/views.
hypotheses.falsifier: End-to-end profiles show no copy/parse reduction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay binary/wire layouts should be immutable/versioned and memory-mappable for large read-mostly graph epochs where platform permits.
hypotheses.falsifier: Mutable/parsed formats outperform without integrity/recovery loss.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic migration of the existing stores into Clay contracts/projections should precede physical database merging.
hypotheses.falsifier: Physical merge first is safer/faster with equal rollback and semantic correctness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shadow projectors and dual-read comparison are necessary before ClayGraph cutover of current stores.
hypotheses.falsifier: Direct cutover matches reliability and accelerates migration materially.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native Clay compact Assemblies benefit the 4B/Android path disproportionately because context/KV bandwidth is a larger fraction of its budget.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched desktop/mobile target measurements show no interaction with assembly compactness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Actual Qwen tokenizer fertility, not character/byte compactness, predicts model-side Clay latency and KV cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Byte/character savings reliably predict token/runtime savings across Clay variants.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay view caches keyed by basis/query/schema/reader hashes can reuse deterministic projections safely and lower latency.
hypotheses.falsifier: Cache hit benefit is outweighed by invalidation/hash overhead or semantic risk.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physical store isolation remains compatible with semantic unity; forcing one physical Clay database is unnecessary for the Clay-native concept.
hypotheses.falsifier: Single physical store demonstrates superior atomicity/performance/recovery without lost isolation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clay-native success requires a benchmark vector: syntax validity, semantic execution, language purity, retained capabilities, memory quality, latency, energy and safety—not one score.
hypotheses.falsifier: One scalar remains stable against Goodhart across training/architecture variants.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit Clay reasoning purity does not prove hidden activations literally use a discrete Clay language; latent-state claims need probes/interventions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Layer-level interventions establish a one-to-one discrete Clay latent code.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-input paraphrases/languages should converge to equivalent Clay semantic state if Clay is truly the model's native symbolic interlingua.
hypotheses.falsifier: Equivalent inputs produce systematically incompatible Clay states after successful training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistence of ClayGraph/self-state will increase functional continuity signals but does not by itself establish causal emergence or phenomenal consciousness.
hypotheses.falsifier: No simple recurrence/persistence confound can explain the measured intervention signature under preregistered controls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: No-field vs truthful-field vs shuffled-field controls become even more important once the model natively consumes ClayGraph activation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Field manipulation has no task/behavior effect after training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A shared Clay semantic world improves long-horizon self-reference only if memory stores action->reason->outcome relations with provenance, not merely self-descriptions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Self-description-only memory matches causal episodic memory on longitudinal tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The strongest evidence that Clay became native will be OOD execution/generalization on unseen Clay compositions, not memorized syntax or low perplexity.
hypotheses.falsifier: In-distribution metrics predict OOD compositional competence reliably.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training and runtime evaluation must retain Goodman/ancestry separation because Clay->FRANK->ClayCode feedback in one shared language can otherwise amplify one error into apparent multi-branch consensus.
hypotheses.falsifier: Ancestry-blind confidence produces no overpromotion in controlled recursive-feedback experiments.
